name: NTT Silicon Valley SV1 Data Center

source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
NTT Silicon Valley SV1 publishes 16 MW of IT capacity at 1160 Walsh Ave., Santa Clara. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 16 MW is roughly 400 racks; at 10 kW per rack, a more typical colocation average, it is closer to 1,600 racks. The arithmetic shifts sharply with rack density, and NTT does not publish a per-rack power figure for this site, so neither number should be read as the operator's claim.

No certifications are listed in the published specifications for this facility, so no statement can be made about what compliance tiers it has achieved. Tenant names, pricing, and available capacity are not published on the operator page this site read.

Among the 103 facilities mapped in California, only five publish a megawatt figure at all. SV1's 16 MW ranks third among those five, which together total 170 MW of published IT capacity, meaning this single campus accounts for roughly 9 percent of what this site can actually count in the state. That share reflects the scarcity of published data more than it reflects the true size of California's data center market, but it does establish SV1 as a meaningful, mid-tier presence within the subset of California facilities that are legible by published numbers.
